title: The merge driver merges appended Change Log rows after a stray leading row
description: The merge driver merges appended Change Log rows after a stray leading row
no_spec_change_rationale: Makes the merge driver match REQ-merge-004 (MERGE-1): two branches that each append a change-log row merge in either order with both rows. A Change Log section opening with a stray headerless row made the driver read that row as the table header, so the row union never ran and the merge conflicted.
acceptance_criteria: Two branches that each bump version 168 to 169 and append a different Change Log row to a section that opens with a stray headerless row merge cleanly in either order with version 170, the stray row once and both new rows (red then green)
